overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting the names of anticipated appointees from the June 6 meeting notice, but not by lacking attachments for two other topics.

allegations.summary: Notice for the June 6 meeting omitted the names of individuals to be appointed to committees, which appeared only in an attached memo.
allegations.key_passage: the names should have been included on the meeting notice itself and not just included in the attached memo, which required users to navigate to a separate page and document.

allegations.summary: Notice did not attach documents for two topics (Professional Development Program amendments and Telework Policy revisions) that were discussed at the June 6 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Commission was not required to include attachments pertaining to each of these topics, even if its usual practice has been to do so.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
